Card Q&A.q: When digivolving this card onto a [Paildramon] or [Dinobeemon] in my breeding area, can I reduce the digivolution cost by 2?

Effect: When one of your [Paildramon] or [Dinobeemon] would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
